stem: A manufacturer is migrating from an on-premises Oracle source to an on-premises PostgreSQL target and asks whether AWS DMS can do that directly.

choices.text: Yes; DMS directly supports on-premises to on-premises migration with no AWS endpoint.
No; with AWS DMS at least one endpoint needs to be on an AWS service.
Yes; if you register both endpoints in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store.
No; because DMS supports only homogeneous migrations within one engine family.

rationale: DMS documentation states one endpoint must be on an AWS service, so purely on-premises source-to-target migration is unsupported in that direct form. Parameter Store registration does not alter this endpoint constraint. DMS supports both homogeneous and heterogeneous engine migrations when the endpoint rule is satisfied.
